# DesignConfigProvider

Compatibility/configuration layer over the same theme and portal boundary.

- **Import:** `import { DesignConfigProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Providers
- **Platforms:** React only.

## Example

It has no stories, so this is the component with its required props.

```tsx
import { DesignConfigProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function DesignConfigProviderExample() {
  return <DesignConfigProvider>Content</DesignConfigProvider>;
}
```

## DesignConfigProvider

Its props are `DesignConfigProviderProps`, which extends `Omit<ThemeProviderProps, "tokens">`.

- `initialConfig`: `DesignConfigInput`, optional.
- `config`: `DesignConfigInput`, optional.

  Controlled configuration. Unspecified fields use defaults, not previous props.

- `onConfigChange`: `(config: DesignConfig) => void`, optional.
- `persistKey`: `string | null`, optional.

  Explicit, module-owned persistence key; controlled config ignores it.

- `tokens`: `Record<string, string>`, optional.
- `dir`: `"ltr" | "rtl"`, optional.
- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.
- `defaultTheme`: `Theme`, optional.
- `theme`: `Theme`, optional.

  Controlled preference. In this mode the caller owns persistence.

- `onThemeChange`: `(theme: Theme) => void`, optional.
- `storageKey`: `string`, optional.

  Persistence is opt-in. Use a key owned by your product/module.

- `defaultSystemTheme`: `ResolvedTheme`, optional.

  Deterministic system fallback for SSR and the first hydration render.

## Types these props take

### DesignConfigInput

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type DesignConfigInput = Omit<
  Partial<DesignConfig>,
  "glass" | "accessibility"
> & {
  glass?: Partial<GlassConfig>;
  accessibility?: Partial<DesignConfig["accessibility"]>;
};
```

### DesignConfig

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface DesignConfig {
  /** @deprecated Legacy radius aliases only. Customize semantic radius tokens instead. */
  roundness: number;
  glass: GlassConfig;
  noise: boolean;
  spotlight: boolean;
  /** @deprecated Legacy shadow aliases only. Customize semantic elevation tokens instead. */
  shadow: "soft" | "hard" | "none";
  motion: "fluid" | "snappy" | "reduced";
  /** @deprecated Metadata only; does not apply a preset. */
  preset?: "apple" | "geometric" | "corporate";
  accessibility: {
    reduceMotion: boolean;
    reduceTransparency: boolean;
  };
}
```

### Theme

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type Theme = "dark" | "light" | "system";
```

### ResolvedTheme

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type ResolvedTheme = Exclude<Theme, "system">;
```
